blocks.text: The Device Groups page displays a list of predefined groups. These groups are defined based on the OS types of the devices in your organization. The devices that have Zscaler Client Connector deployed are categorized under respective groups based on their OS type.
The Device Groups page provides you with the following benefits and allows you to:

blocks.item: Organize devices into logical groups to apply Internet & SaaS security policies to many devices at once.
Have granular controls when applying different rules for different device groups, such as corporate laptops, mobile devices, or IoT devices, etc.

blocks.text: On the Device Groups page (Administration > Internet & SaaS Authentication > Internet & SaaS Device Management > Device Groups), you can:

blocks.item: Modify the table and its columns.
View a list of all configured device groups. For each device group, you can view the following information:
Group Name: The name of the device group.
OS Type: The OS type of the device.
No. of Devices: The number of devices belonging to the device group.
Description: The description of the device
View more information about the device group.
Go to the VDI Devices and VDI Device Groups pages.
